candidate_program.name: gap_adjusted_efficiency
candidate_program.rationale: Balances reward per duration and continuously scaled contact-gap overhead against normalized conflict weight. Uses only base features, adding no graph operations; the overhead approximation can miss neighborhood overlap.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap) * degree / (1 + degree)) - 0.25 * conflict_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
